Rina: Uh oh 1 1 our wireless receiver in Studio 1 just dropped two mics. Moving the stream to Studio 2 wired setup. Expect ~7m delay. Keep questions in-thread.
Marco: Copy. Presenters please head to Studio 2 now and bring adapters.
AV Bot: mic-loss detected -> RX#4 ; auto-switch to wired fallback initiated.
DevOps: Im standing up the fallback bridge (rtmp://bridge.fallback/redwood). Recording will be on fallback-rec-02.
Elise: Can we push the roadmap Q&A to immediately after intros? Two customers are on standby and need early answers.
Rina: Good call 1 roadmap right after intros. Leadership, are you good with that?
product-bot: leadership-confirmation: accepted (slot: post-intro).
Tom: Quick note on captions 1 switching sources may induce ~10-18s lag for the first few minutes. I'll warm up the captioner now.
Nora: If the live demo struggles, I can produce a short 90s clip and upload it. Command I use locally: `ffmpeg -f x11grab -r 30 -s 1280x720 -i :0.0 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast /tmp/demo90s.mp4`
Marco: Slides 1 please re-upload final deck to /handouts/allhands/2026-05-02-final.pdf so we point the stream at the new file.
Rina: Action list: 1) Move to Studio 2 + mic swap 1 Marco/AV. 2) Slides re-upload 1 Presenters. 3) Roadmap frontloaded 1 Leadership/Product. 4) Demo clip fallback + S3 upload 1 Nora. 5) Timestamp Q&A in notes 1 Elise. I'll post a go/no-go in 6m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
AV Bot: wired-fallback-status -> ready ; levels set to -6 dB ; no clipping.
Tom: Captioner warmed, latency estimate ~12s. Monitoring drift.
Marco: Uploaded v9 to /handouts/allhands/2026-05-02-final.pdf and notified folks.
Nora: Will record demo and upload to s3://redwood-internal/allhands/2026-05-02/demo90s.mp4 after the event. Will post link here.
Elise: I'll maintain the timestamp doc during the stream: https://redwood/internal/allhands/2026-05-02/notes and paste timestamps here. Leadership will take the first 10 minutes of roadmap Qs then open floor.
Rina: Ok moving people now. Presenters: Studio 2 in 4 mins. Ping me here if you need a dongle. :pushpin:
All: :thumbsup:
